title: StarterGui
summary: The template container for GUIs: its contents are COPIED into each player's PlayerGui when they spawn. Editing StarterGui at runtime does NOT change already-spawned players' screens.

methods.name: SetCore
methods.description: Client only. Controls built-in core UI: e.g. SetCore("ResetButtonCallback", false), SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {...}).

methods.name: GetCoreGuiEnabled / SetCoreGuiEnabled
methods.description: Client only. Read/toggle built-in core GUIs (chat, leaderboard, backpack…).

properties.name: ResetPlayerGuiOnSpawn
properties.description: Whether players' PlayerGui is cleared and re-copied from StarterGui on each respawn (default true).

details.heading: Template semantics
details.body: At spawn, the engine copies StarterGui's contents into the player's PlayerGui. From then on the LIVE GUI is the PlayerGui copy — server-side edits to StarterGui affect only future spawns.

explanation.whatItIs: The mold your GUIs are cast from. You design in StarterGui; each player gets their own fresh copy at spawn in PlayerGui.
explanation.whyItExists: Every player needs their own independent copy of the UI (their health bar, their buttons) — the template pattern gives that automatically.
whenToUse: Placing ScreenGuis, LocalScripts for UI, and anything UI-related that should exist per-player
Using SetCore/SetCoreGuiEnabled to manage Roblox's built-in UI (client)
whenNotToUse: For runtime GUI changes — manipulate the copy in PlayerGui instead
For one-off world-space UI — BillboardGui/SurfaceGui parented in workspace instead
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
StarterGui (TEMPLATE)          PlayerGui (LIVE COPY)
 ├─ MainHUD          ──copy→    ├─ MainHUD
 └─ ShopGui          ──copy→    └─ ShopGui

Changing StarterGui now ≠ changing players' screens.
Change PlayerGui = change THIS player's screen now.
```
tips: LocalScripts inside StarterGui GUIs run per-player after the copy lands in PlayerGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn controls whether that specific GUI survives respawn
To update everyone's HUD from the server, fire a RemoteEvent and let each client update its own PlayerGui
commonMistakes: The classic: editing StarterGui at runtime and wondering why nothing changes on screen (see gotcha)
Writing to StarterGui from the client — clients don't have a meaningful StarterGui; use PlayerGui
Forgetting PlayerGui lives under each PLAYER: player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

examples.title: Updating the RIGHT gui at runtime
examples.code:
-- ❌ WRONG: template edits don't touch live screens
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
-- StarterGui.MainHUD.CashLabel.Text = "999"  -- pointless at runtime

-- ✅ RIGHT (LocalScript): edit the live copy
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local hud = playerGui:WaitForChild("MainHUD")
hud.CashLabel.Text = "999"
examples.commonMistake: StarterGui vs PlayerGui is the #1 'my GUI won't update' bug. Template = StarterGui; live screen = PlayerGui.
